# YOOV WORK | Product Overview

YOV WORK is a local cloud HR/office management product covering personnel, remuneration, shift attendance and mobile office. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
